test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
By folding the given paper, which of the following box can be made?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27a5c7776fa81dd3d8666b815a52fe8b5d3e270ff4ae879c26102a2e73947219.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32bc66896aec32c845983ab35c07877f34301cee1b57f38c7dc88371c6c9ed75.png] 

7 and 2 is the opposite sides.

3 and 6 is the opposite sides.

4 and @ is the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be the adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shows in a dice.

Now,

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a4cd7f47e5fb2acbc291809399177dbd313f2da4e8068dc488691a24d5c21f1.png] → Can not be made, because 4 and @ is the opposite sides.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c490937393cf00b6d12e8efdfa8decb8e403fc3aa44a53fa6073888ed7904b9e.png] → Can not be made, because 7 and 2 is the opposite sides.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81d9ce75efa37e7d541e8e89dc1a4f4cf46e3f5d41ce6ee61f50ea37153c48fe.png] → Can not be made, because 3 and 6 is the opposite sides

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c70eb8e232e7a19eb3513bb2155b200bbc9eb12b646938e8e59872043db03706.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
